maya: Quick sync — we need to lock the runtime perf bets for Q3 planning. Customers (two large search SaaS deals) are asking for tighter p50/p95 on long-context gen and cheaper embeddings.
ben: TL;DR: pick 3 measurable bets: 1) KV cache LRU + cold-hit reduction, 2) int8 quant trade study for Llama-family kernels, 3) routing policy to prefer low-latency nodes with cost fallbacks.
joan: Agree with bets but we must add launch criteria per-bet. e.g., KV: reduce cold-start p95 by 30% on 8k seq vs baseline.
ravi: Ops note — any change that increases GPU memory needs or kernel variants will impact Dedicated capacity plans. We need cost delta < 12% for enterprise customers or flag as opt-in.
maya: Good point. Let's define measurable metrics: 
- KV cold-hit rate (pct)
- p95 token latency (ms) @ 8k
- CPU overhead on router (pct)
- cost-per-1M-tokens delta (pct)

ben: Proposed rollout policy snippet for experiments: 
```
rollout: 
  canary: 10% traffic for 2d
  metrics: [p95_token_latency, kv_cold_hit_rate, error_rate]
  abort_if: p95_token_latency > baseline*1.15 or error_rate > 0.5%
```
joan: Add quality gate for model outputs too — sampling-based eval on 200 canonical prompts, acceptance if no regression > 2% on ROUGE/accuracy.
maya: For quant, define two tracks: research (aggressive int4 attempts, internal-only) and conservative (int8 with kernel fallback). Owners?
ben: I'll own quant track conservatively with eng-ml. Research track — joan + ravi to coordinate infra for experimental nodes.
ravi: We'll reserve a pool of 8 A100s for the research track, but we need timeline and rollback plan. Also need to update Dedicated pricing sheet if research causes higher memory footprints.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-pool update at 2026-05-02T03:00Z => canary nodes: 20 -> 24 (no impact expected).
maya: Customer-driven asks: 
- SearchCo: wants p95 < 180ms for 4k.
- FinData: needs private deployment quant certification + KMS audit log for any new kernel.
We should prioritize SearchCo low-latency routing experiment.
joan: For kernels, propose we benchmark three kernel sets: baseline, fused-attn, and kernel-quant-optimized. Deliverable: a perf matrix by May 20 with p50/p95 and memory.
ben: Agree. Also add cost estimator module to Console so PMs can preview cost delta per-route. I'll spike a minimal UI for Q3 roadmap demo.
maya: Final decision asks: commit to 2 primary bets (KV cold-hit + routing latency-aware) and 1 hedge (int8 conservative rollout). If we hit canary metrics by mid-Q3 then full rollout.
ravi: I'll produce capacity impact doc by EOD Friday with worst-case numbers.
joan: I'll own the kernel benchmark matrix and the quality eval harness.
ben: I'll own the routing rollout config + Console cost preview spike.
maya: Great. Action items summarized: 
- ravi: capacity impact doc (due Fri)
- joan: kernel perf matrix + eval harness (due May 20)
- ben: routing rollout config + console spike (due May 10)
- maya: consolidate launch criteria and customer ask doc and share with sales (due Mon)

ben: one more ask — can we add an SLA decision: if routing falls back to cheaper model we should signal via request header so app can degrade gracefully.
maya: yes, add header X-Redwood-Fallback: <tier>. Good call.
joan: :thumbsup:
maya: OK closing — will update the roadmap doc and link to this thread. Keep comments short if you see any blockers.
